by
  intro h'
  apply MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass.of_charFunDual
  intros x y
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFunDual_apply]
  apply MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_of_charFunDual
  intro s
  apply eq_of_null_set_measure
  apply measure_theory.measure_eq_ae
  intro t
  apply measure_theory.ae_iff
  intro ht
  apply measure_theory.ae_iff
  intro ht'
  have : μ ≠ MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x := h' x
  cases this with h'' h'''
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ProbabilityTheory.is_gaussian_exists_char_fun_map f hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ProbabilityTheory.is_gaussian_exists_char_fun_map g hg
  have : μ = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x :=
    by rw [hf, hg]; exact MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_of_charFunDual h''
  contradiction
